title: The Ogre's Kitchen
text: An ogre is cooking a stew big enough to bathe in, stirring it with a cartwheel and humming happily. It is friendly; it waves. It is short of one ingredient, it says, and it looks at the party the way a cook looks at a market stall.

options.label: The cleverest offers to cook for it, before it decides what else goes in the pot.

outcomes.text: It loves the stew so much it forgets what it meant to add, and pays in shiny things. It licks the cartwheel clean.

options.label: Give it your food instead, hoping a full ogre is a friendly one.

outcomes.text: Its gratitude comes in ogre gifts, heavy and hard to carry. It will keep you safe a while.

options.label: Fight it now, before it finishes deciding.
